description: This Java class provides a supplier for configuration objects based on the environment in which the service runs. It distinguishes between cloud, docker, file-based, and development environments, and loads corresponding configuration resources accordingly.

classes.name: ServiceSpecificEnvironmentConfigSupplier
classes.description: A final class implementing Supplier<Config> that provides environment-specific configuration loading logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance with a given service name, using the current system environment.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a Config object based on the determined hosting environment.

methods.name: determineHostingEnvironment
methods.description: Determines the hosting environment based on the systemHostingEnvironment string.

methods.name: getConfigFromResource
methods.description: Parses configuration resource for a given hosting environment.

methods.name: getResourceBasename
methods.description: Constructs resource basename string based on service name and environment.

methods.name: withHostingEnvironmentValue
methods.description: Augments a Config object with the current hosting environment value.

methods.name: getHostingEnvironmentConfig
methods.description: Creates a ConfigValue representing the current hosting environment.
